name: Neural Illumination Fields (NeIF)
definition: NeIF is a fully differentiable framework that uses volumetric radiance fields (density and color) to express the incoming rays of each surface point, treating each sample in the 3D scene as a light emitter to handle environment occlusions and directional lighting.
summary: Neural Illumination Fields represent 3D ambient illumination as a continuous volumetric radiance field, enabling environment occlusion handling and material-light decomposition unlike distant-light methods.
